META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml.text:
modLoader="javafml" #mandatory
loaderVersion="[2,)" #mandatory
license="All rights reserved"

[[mods]] #mandatory
modId="idas" #mandatory
logoFile="../assets/idas/idas_logo.png"
    logoBlur=false
    version="1.13.7+1.21.1-neoforge" #mandatory
    displayName="Integrated Dungeons and Structures" #mandatory
displayURL="https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/idas"
    authors="CraisinLord"
    credits="Special thanks to TelpathicGrunt for thier structure tutorial and help with coding! And Bdubs, GoodTimesWithScar and Mythical Sausage for building inspirations!"
    description='''
    Integrated Dungeons and Structures (aka IDAS) is a mod that adds heavily detailed structures using blocks and mobs from Quark, Biomes O’ Plenty, Alex’s Mobs, and Create.
    '''
[[mixins]]
    config = "idas-common.mixins.json"


[[dependencies.idas]]
    modId="minecraft"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.21.1,)"

[[dependencies.idas]]
    modId="create"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="*"

[[dependencies.idas]]
    modId="supplementaries"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="*"

[[dependencies.idas]]
    modId="quark"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="*"

[[dependencies.idas]]
    modId="integrated_api"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="*"
